review.why: Generates read-and-share slide decks as AI images from an outline and one prompt per slide, merged into PPTX and PDF.
review.summary: Turns content into an outline, then one prompt file per slide, then raster slide images through an available image backend, and merges them into PPTX and PDF. It offers 17 style presets built from four dimensions, a confirmation gate before generating, batch generation, and rules to edit the prompt then regenerate.
strengths: One prompt file per slide: reproducible and independent of the image backend
Asks for confirmation before generating unless the user opts out
Never patches text inside a generated image: it regenerates
cautions: Slides are images: their text cannot be edited in PowerPoint
Needs an image generation backend, which may be paid or require a login
Designed for reading and sharing, not for live presentation
